pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-chat-interlocutor against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.9 §12, gate 20); the behaviour simai/ui-chat's tests/browser/staff.test.mjs holds for it: one interlocutor names it and offers no choice, two are a choice, an old thread with neither is «Помощник»
pages.format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

body: <sf-chat-interlocutor id="two" value="personal"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"options": [{"id": "personal", "title": "Мой помощник", "kind": "personal"}, {"id": "shop", "title": "Поддержка магазина", "kind": "knowledge"}]}</script></sf-chat-interlocutor>

checks.title: two interlocutors: the button names the current one, is a closed menu button described by what a change does; a press opens the Framework's menu with two radio rows, the current one checked, the own and the knowledge base's under their headings and a closing heading that says a change starts a new conversation
checks.covers: settings.options, values.value, accessibility.name runtime.button-label, keyboard.host Enter open, actions.open

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#two .sf-chat-interlocutor__button'); const note = document.getElementById(b.getAttribute('aria-describedby')); return b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Помощник: Мой помощник' && b.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'menu' && b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && !b.disabled && note?.textContent === 'При смене помощника начнётся новый разговор' && note.classList.contains('sr-only') && b.querySelector('.sf-chat-interlocutor__title').textContent === 'Мой помощник'; })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#two .sf-context-menu-item[role=menuitemradio]')]; return rows.length === 2 && rows[0].getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true' && rows[1].getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'false' && rows[1].textContent.includes('Поддержка магазина') && document.querySelector('#two .sf-chat-interlocutor__button').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' && [...document.querySelectorAll('#two .sf-context-menu-heading')].map((one) => one.textContent.trim()).join('|') === 'Мои помощники|Помощники баз|При смене помощника начнётся новый разговор'; })()

checks.title: choosing another interlocutor sends sf-chat-interlocutor-select {id} once and the 0.3 name sf-chat-interlocutor once, noted with its dates; the element leaves value to the host
choosing the current interlocutor again sends nothing

one interlocutor: the header names it and offers no choice that does not exist -- a disabled button without aria-haspopup, aria-expanded or a description, the --single class, open refused single and no menu rows

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#one .sf-chat-interlocutor__button'); return b.disabled && b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Помощник: Мой помощник' && !b.hasAttribute('aria-haspopup') && !b.hasAttribute('aria-expanded') && !b.hasAttribute('aria-describedby') && document.querySelector('#one .sf-chat-interlocutor--single') !== null && document.querySelectorAll('#one [role=menuitemradio]').length === 0; })()

checks.title: a conversation with an interlocutor the server no longer lists is named «Помощник», never an empty line or undefined
from eight interlocutors the menu has its search «Найти помощника»; the person's own and the knowledge bases' go under their headings
checks.covers: settings.options kind knowledge, runtime.search-placeholder, runtime.group-own-text, runtime.group-knowledge-text

steps.check: (() => { const field = document.querySelector('#many .sf-context-menu-search-input'); const headings = [...document.querySelectorAll('#many .sf-context-menu-heading')].map((one) => one.textContent.trim()); return field?.getAttribute('placeholder') === 'Найти помощника' && headings.includes('Мои помощники') && headings.includes('Помощники баз') && document.querySelectorAll('#many [role=menuitemradio]').length === 9; })()

checks.title: set-options, the 0.3 setOptions(list): no list is a name only; two make the button a choice

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#late .sf-chat-interlocutor__button'); return !b.disabled && b.getAttribute('aria-haspopup') === 'menu' && b.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Помощник: Мой помощник' && !document.querySelector('#late .sf-chat-interlocutor--single'); })()
